data.name: fh_ImportNote
data.value:
Import is a read-only operation; it changes nothing in AD. The system reads unit accounts from the organizational units and opens an occupancy record using the name held in description, only for units that have no open occupancy record. The import may therefore be repeated safely: it never closes an existing record nor edits its data.
For imported records the tenancy start date is the import date, not the account creation date, because AD does not retain the resident's move-in date and the account may have been created years ago and held by several residents. These records are marked «Imported» so the date is not later read as verified.
